The plate is square, about 340 px wide in the image. If it is a side plate of roughly 22 cm, that gives about 15 px per cm.

The pear is about 135 px wide and 130 px tall, so roughly 8.5–9 cm across. It is probably 9–10 cm tall, which makes it a medium pear of about 200 g.

The broccoli is two small clusters. The larger one is about 120 px, or 8 cm, across and perhaps 4 cm tall, so it weighs about 40 g. The smaller floret is about 55 px, or 3.5 cm, and weighs about 12 g. Together the broccoli comes to about 50 g.
